Code Relay

Hand implementation work to Claude Code and shuttle it back by copy-paste.
SKILL · RUNS AUTOMATICALLY WHEN IT APPLIES

What it does

Turns this agent into the "architect" half of a two-way relay with Claude Code (the Code-tab coding agent). It produces a one-click handoff prompt that sets the role split - the architect decides and reviews; Claude Code implements, tests, and pushes - and orders Claude Code to end every reply with a copy-ready status block, so the back-and-forth loop closes on its own.

When to use it

When you want to hand a coding job to Claude Code and pass messages back and forth, or when you paste back a block headed === FOR THE ARCHITECT ===. Not for writing the code here, running git, or handoffs to anything other than Claude Code.

How to trigger it

"hand this to Claude Code"

"make a Claude Code prompt"

"relay to Code"

"start a relay"
